payload.subject: Phase 2 Interview skill — pick a home
payload.rationale: Phase 2 of Generative Sample Libraries is goal-defined and gate-defined but home-undefined. The Goal is to codify the Interview as a real artifact — questions, defaults, sensible opinionated decisions. The two hard gates are settled (convention agreement before rendering; audition cycle before full batch — both burned-in by the Phase 1 Kokoro pronunciation bug). What is not settled is where the artifact lives. Without a home, Phase 2 stays specified-but-unstarted. The GSL entry's Open Questions section names this directly: 'Where does the Interview skill (Phase 2) live in the palace's skill ecosystem?' Per growing-stage posture (Substrate Skill § Stage as Alignment Confidence), this is exactly the kind of routine directional decision that warrants a non-blocking Trickster ask rather than a Steward unilateral choice — three viable homes, distinct tradeoffs, no clear default.

options.label: (a) Plugin/user-skill — /skills/sample-library-interview/SKILL.md
options.tradeoff_for: Auto-discovery and reuse. Becomes loadable like pptx, docx, brand-guidelines — Claude triggers it whenever a sample-library task appears. Lives in the user-skill space, portable across machines.
options.tradeoff_against: Premature standardization. The Interview has only been run once (Kokoro TTS, Phase 1). Codifying as a global auto-loading skill before multi-source validation risks baking in Kokoro-shaped assumptions that don't generalize to palace synthesis, local WAV folders, or AI sub-agent sources.

options.label: (b) Project-local skill — _ops/sample-libraries/skills/interview/SKILL.md
options.tradeoff_for: Honest scope. Lives where the work lives, alongside the existing _ops/sample-libraries/talking-keyboard/ artifact. Easy to iterate without treating it as a palace-wide commitment. Promotion path to (a) is cheap once Phase 3 multi-source validation has shaped the question tree.
options.tradeoff_against: Won't be auto-discovered by the skill-loading system. Each session has to be pointed at it manually. Slower path to becoming default behavior across sample-library work.

options.label: (c) Section in the GSL entry itself
options.tradeoff_for: Maximally lightweight. No new artifact, no skill-system commitment. The Interview becomes prose Claude reads when GSL is the active topic.
options.tradeoff_against: Doesn't compose with skill auto-loading. The entry already runs long; embedding the Interview makes it longer. The Interview's job is to be invoked when *any* sample-library task starts, not just when the GSL entry is read — section-in-GSL doesn't deliver that.

payload.steward_recommendation: (b) Project-local skill at _ops/sample-libraries/skills/interview/SKILL.md. Reasoning: matches the growing-stage posture (execute within established direction; checkpoint at sensory steps; do not over-commit before evidence). The skill is real, but committing to (a) before Phase 3's multi-source validation has tested the question tree against at least one non-TTS source risks codifying a Kokoro-shaped Interview as palace-canonical. (b) keeps the artifact close to its evidence base. Promotion to (a) is a one-line move — copy the file into the user-skill space — once Phase 3 has shaped the questions against palace-synthesis or local-WAV sources.
payload.decision_needed: Pick (a), (b), (c), or volunteer a different location. Steward will then propose the SKILL.md skeleton in the next cycle; full skeleton awaits your pick because the location shapes the framing.

_pilot_metadata.posture_check: This is a non-sensory routine directional decision; blocking: false is correct per Substrate Skill posture table for growing-stage.
